proof_availability.classification_scope: For a fixed exact-rational linear forward map H:Q^n->Q^m, certified independent relations CH=D and all retained forcing-response pairs determine precisely H=H0+NZT. Columns of N span ker C and ker T is the span of all queried inputs. A new linear response functional <W,H> is already determined iff N^T W T^T=0; otherwise exactly rank(N^T W T^T) additional full-vector forward experiments suffice and are necessary for deterministic exact worst-case answers over the unrestricted rational completion class. The generated inputs can have infinity norm at most one; all new responses are retained after evaluating the old factorization. The1143square-response software extension replaces exact-response semantics by the common feasible set K={H:||BH-I||_2<=rho, |HF-Y|<=delta}. Every explicit multiplier U yields a valid task interval by a nuclear-norm support bound plus the charged response boxes. Two explicit compatible operators can certify information insufficiency within this set. A checked software Jacobi contraction supplies a real precision/sweep menu; fixed-menu deterministic residual-ball minimax error pairs the smallest noise budgets with the largest task singular values.
